summary: REQ-2 and REQ-3 appear largely implemented (admin role selection in signup UI, password gate, backend server-side password check, and user-friendly English error translation). REQ-1 is partially supported on the frontend (admin-only navigation/access denied screen), but the diff summary is insufficient to confirm the backend `listUsers` behavior (admin-only and returning all users). Several unrequested features/restrictions were added (admin allowlist gating, system reset/purge tooling, and signup-flow debug logging).

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend `listUsers` API remains admin-only and returns all user profiles stored in the canister.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary for `backend/main.mo` is truncated and does not show any `listUsers` implementation or authorization checks for listing users; only frontend gating is visible.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin allowlist gating based on specific names and additional restrictions on admin role assignment beyond the requested admin-signup password gate.
